name: content-research-agent
title: Content Research Agent
does: Finds trending topics, summarizes articles and gives you content ideas for your niche.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: found current trends and returned 17 source links. Web search is built in.
prompt: Use the content-research-agent: find what's trending in [my niche] for [my audience] on [platform] and give me 10 content ideas with sources.

name: social-media-scheduler-agent
title: Social Media Scheduler Agent
does: Writes posts, plans the visuals and lays them out on a posting schedule.
reason: Writes posts, image briefs and a schedule (test passed). Through Zapier it can now publish to Instagram (photos and videos), your Facebook Page and Pinterest, once you approve each post. Nothing has been posted yet, LinkedIn isn't connected, and posts go out when approved rather than on a timer.
nextStep: Ask the agent for one approved test post to Instagram to confirm it works end to end. Connect LinkedIn in Zapier if you post there, and Buffer or Hootsuite if you want posts to go out on a schedule.
connectors: Zapier (connected): Instagram for Business, Facebook Pages, Pinterest
prompt: Use the social-media-scheduler-agent: plan [2 weeks] of posts for [my business] on [Instagram and LinkedIn], [3] posts a week each. We're promoting [offer]. Include what each image should show.

name: customer-support-agent
title: Customer Support Agent
does: Answers customer questions, handles FAQs and drafts replies, and escalates anything risky to you.
reason: Drafts accurate replies and escalates edge cases (test passed), but it has no saved knowledge base, so you have to paste your policies every time.
nextStep: Add your FAQ, returns, shipping and refund policies as files in the repo (for example docs/support/policies.md) so the agent answers from them automatically.
prompt: Use the customer-support-agent to work through this support queue. Our policies: [paste policies]. Messages: [paste customer messages].

name: email-assistant-agent
title: Email Assistant Agent
does: Sorts your inbox, drafts replies in your voice, flags what matters and tracks follow-ups.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: sorted the emails, flagged a phishing attempt and saved your sign-off to its memory. Gmail is connected. Not yet run on your live inbox.
prompt: Use the email-assistant-agent: go through my unread Gmail from the last [2 days], sort it, draft replies where needed and list follow-ups that are due. Don't send anything.

name: personal-finance-agent
title: Personal Finance Agent
does: Tracks your spending, compares it to your budget and finds realistic savings.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: totals were correct and it caught a duplicate charge. It works from a bank export (CSV) or pasted transactions.
connectors: Bank CSV export or pasted transactions; web search for price checks
prompt: Use the personal-finance-agent: here are this month's transactions [paste or attach CSV]. My budget is [$ amount]. Where is my money going and how can I save?

name: learning-study-agent
title: Learning & Study Agent
does: Builds study plans, explains hard topics simply and quizzes you on what matters.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: built a day-by-day plan and started a quiz. It saves your progress to its memory.
prompt: Use the learning-study-agent: I want to learn [topic] by [date] with [hours] a week. Make me a plan and quiz me to start.

name: market-analysis-agent
title: Market Analysis Agent
does: Tracks your competitors and market trends and turns them into a few clear decisions.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: built a sourced competitor table and three insights with actions.
prompt: Use the market-analysis-agent: my business is [describe]. Track what [competitor 1], [competitor 2] and [competitor 3] are doing and give me insights I can act on.

name: recruitment-agent
title: Recruitment Agent
does: Screens resumes against a fair scorecard, shortlists candidates and preps interviews.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: scored candidates on job evidence only and never used age. Works from pasted or saved resumes.
connectors: Resumes you paste or save in the repo
prompt: Use the recruitment-agent: we're hiring a [role]. Must-haves: [list]. Nice-to-haves: [list]. Screen these applicants: [paste resumes].

name: travel-planner-agent
title: Travel Planner Agent
does: Compares flights and hotels, builds a day-by-day itinerary and adds local tips.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: built a day-by-day plan within budget. It plans and compares; you do the booking.
prompt: Use the travel-planner-agent: plan [3] days in [city] for [2] people in [month], flying from [city], about [$ budget]. We like [interests].

name: sales-lead-gen-agent
title: Sales & Lead Gen Agent
does: Finds potential customers, qualifies them as hot or warm and writes personal outreach.
reason: Finds and qualifies leads and drafts outreach (test passed), but no CRM is connected, so leads aren't saved anywhere.
nextStep: Connect a CRM such as HubSpot so leads and follow-ups are saved. Until then it gives you a CSV of leads.
connectors: Web search; Gmail (connected) for approved sends
prompt: Use the sales-lead-gen-agent: I sell [service] in [area] to [type of customer]. Find potential customers, qualify them and write first outreach for the best ones.

name: file-document-agent
title: File & Document Agent
does: Summarizes documents, converts file formats and organizes folders, always with an undo log.
reason: Ready. Passed its test: the summary kept every number, owner and deadline. Works on files in your repo.
prompt: Use the file-document-agent: summarize [file path or pasted document] with key points, decisions and action items.

name: creative-assistant-agent
title: Creative Assistant Agent
does: Brainstorms ideas, writes drafts and plans visuals to get a creative project finished.
reason: Ready. Passed its test (ideas, draft and visual brief). Canva is now connected through Zapier, so it can create designs and export them, with your approval. It hasn't made a design yet.
prompt: Use the creative-assistant-agent: help me with [project] for [audience]. It's for [where it'll be used], due [date]. Give me ideas, a draft and a visual brief.
